profile.title: Business profile
profile.intro: What your quotations and invoices say about your business. Only roles that may change settings see it, because it holds your bank details.
profile.legalNameHint: As registered for GST, or as your bank knows it.
profile.gstinHint: Leave it empty if your business isn't registered for GST.
profile.gstStateHint: Where your business is registered. It decides whether a sale carries CGST and SGST, or IGST.
profile.bankHint: Printed on your invoices, so customers know where to pay.
profile.bankAccountNumberSaved: Only its last four digits are shown.
profile.invoicePrefixHint: 2-5 letters your invoice numbers start with, such as SH for SH-2026-0042.

problems.legalName: Give your business's legal name, in up to 120 characters.
problems.gstin: Check the GSTIN: 15 characters, ending in a check character that must match.
problems.gstinOfAnotherState: This GSTIN is registered in {state}. Choose that state, or check the GSTIN.
problems.gstStateCode: Choose the state your business is registered in.
problems.contactName: Use a name of up to 100 characters.
problems.bankIfsc: Check the IFSC: 11 characters, the fifth a zero.
problems.invoicePrefixReserved: These letters number the app's own documents, such as its samples. Choose others.

setup.title: Set up your organization
setup.intro: A few things to do before your first quotation. Each step opens the screen where it is done.

contact-phone.title: Contact phone
contact-phone.hint: The number your customers and your documents show

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Your logo, on your quotations and invoices

branding.title: Branding
branding.hint: Your colour and terms, on the documents you issue

bank-details.title: Bank details
bank-details.hint: The account your customers pay into

invoice-prefix.title: Invoice prefix
invoice-prefix.hint: The letters your invoice numbers start with

staff.title: Staff
staff.hint: Add your staff and give each a role

files.title: Business files
files.intro: Papers your business keeps to hand: its GST certificate, PAN card, licences, a cancelled cheque. Only roles that may change settings see them.
files.empty: No files yet. Upload your GST certificate, PAN card or a cancelled cheque.

attachments.allowed: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 25 MB.
attachments.sensitivityHint: This can't be changed later. To change it, remove the file and upload it again.
attachments.sensitiveHint: Papers with personal or bank details, such as a PAN card or a cancelled cheque. Only roles allowed to see sensitive files see its name and can open or remove it.
attachments.notSensitiveHint: Papers such as a GST certificate or a licence. Every role that may see these files sees its name and can open it.
attachments.storageUnreachable: The file didn't reach storage. Check your connection and try again.
attachments.storageRefused: Storage didn't accept the file. Try again.

problems.type: {name} can't be uploaded. Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC file.
problems.size: {name} is larger than 25 MB. Choose a smaller file.
problems.name: This file's name can't be used. Rename it and try again.

attachments.sensitiveHidden: Your role can't open sensitive files.
attachments.removeDescription: It goes from this list for everyone. Removed files still count toward your plan's storage.
